title: Tanker Shipping - September 8, 2026
summary: Atlantic Strength and Hormuz Risk Support VLCC Premiums - Firmer enquiry Short-term Indicators from the US Gulf, Brazil and West Africa is absorbing prompt VLCC tonnage and Momentum: Positive limiting the number of ships available to ballast towards the Middle East while owners considering Arabian Gulf employment must also factor in the security, Sentiment: Positive insurance and operational exposure associated with Hormuz, increasing the cost Fundamentals: Positive of attracting vessels east. Iraq's Basrah exports recovered alongside improved, although still selective, access through Hormuz, with Iraqi crude exports increasing Breakwave Tanker from approximately 1.35 mb/d in July to ~2.35 mb/d in August after certain tankers 11230 Futures Index: were permitted to transit. Still, volumes remained below pre-war levels, with 30D: 73.8% ↑ Basrah cargoes continuing to rely on a smaller pool of vessels prepared and able to enter the Gulf.
